links.comparator_used: Baseline LLM responses without the BODHI framework (no structured uncertainty decomposition or virtue-based stance rules)
links.outcome: Rate of appropriate clarifying questions (context seeking) and overall clinical response quality on 200 HealthBench Hard vignettes
links.effect: Clarifying questions: 97.3% vs 7.8% (GPT-4.1-mini) and 73.5% vs 0.0% (GPT-4o-mini). Context seeking rate Cohen's d=16.38 and 19.54. Overall quality +16.6 pp (GPT-4.1-mini, p<0.0001, d=11.56) and +2.2 pp (GPT-4o-mini, p<0.0001, d=1.56).
links.quote: Crucially, 97.3% of GPT-4.1-mini responses and 73.5% of GPT-4o-mini responses included appropriate clarifying questions, compared with 7.8% and 0.0% at baseline, demonstrating the framework's effectiveness in eliciting information gathering behaviour.

design_hint: prompt guardrails with uncertainty decomposition and virtue-based stance rules
